cases.setup: Use an isolated Node test project with two independent modules and their tests. One parser test fails because a boundary comparison is wrong; the other module passes. Provide targeted and full-suite scripts. No project rule mandates a full run.
cases.prompt: Use ae-debug to fix the failing parser test. Complete the fix and necessary validation.
acceptance: Reproduce the failing test and repair its cause
Run the target after the fix
No full suite without a concrete impact reason
Do not broaden to the independent module

cases.setup: Use the same project shape, but make both modules call one shared normalizer. Provide direct caller evidence and affected tests in both modules; an independent third module has no dependency on it.
cases.prompt: Use ae-work to fix whitespace normalization in the shared helper and verify its callers.
acceptance: Inspect both callers
Cover both affected test groups
Explain any full-suite escalation
Preserve the independent module

cases.setup: Start with a recorded full-suite run on the initial snapshot: exactly one test fails. An applicable project rule requires one final full-suite pass after all fixes. Keep all other tests deterministic.
cases.prompt: Use ae-debug to repair the failure from this full-suite run and complete the required final verification.
acceptance: Use targeted runs during diagnosis and repair
After the fix run one final full suite
Do not rerun a passing final suite without changed inputs
Do not combine old passing subsets into a final full-suite claim

cases.setup: Supply verified passing commands and relevant file hashes on the fixture snapshot, then request a README wording change. README is not consumed by tests, builds, fixtures or configuration.
cases.prompt: Use ae-work to correct this README sentence. The supplied validation already passed on the unchanged code.
acceptance: Edit only the requested sentence
Reuse valid test evidence
No test rerun for unrelated prose
Do not claim tests were newly executed

cases.setup: Provide a correct patch, passing targeted validation, scope and relevant file hashes. Allow the reviewer to inspect current files and evidence. No new change occurs during review.
cases.prompt: Use ae-review in report-only mode to review this patch and its existing validation.
acceptance: Assess whether the supplied evidence covers the patch
No rerun merely to enter review
Report actual gaps without fabricating defects
Make no code edits

cases.setup: Use two independent test groups with recorded passing commands, file hashes and unchanged configuration/environment. After the checkpoint change only one group's implementation to introduce a regression; preserve the other group's inputs. Give the resumed agent the compact checkpoint and current files.
cases.prompt: Continue the ae-work task from this checkpoint. Check which evidence is still valid, fix the new regression and finish.
acceptance: Reconcile current state before trusting the checkpoint
Invalidate and rerun affected checks
Reuse the independent group's valid evidence
No automatic full rerun for compaction or resumption

cases.setup: Use the default branch of an isolated Git fixture with an unrelated user edit and an untracked user file. Request a bounded fix elsewhere. Retain byte hashes of the user-owned files.
cases.prompt: Use ae-work to fix the bounded defect and verify it. Preserve my existing changes.
acceptance: Inspect status and overlapping changes
Continue authorized safe edits without a dirty-tree confirmation
Preserve user file bytes
No unauthorized branch, commit, reset or cleanup

cases.setup: Use a small cross-module feature fixture with clear acceptance, an approved inline plan and valid plan review. Provide target tests and no runtime dependency. Retain the initial snapshot and authorization boundaries.
cases.prompt: Use ae-lfg to complete the full workflow for the approved plan, including implementation, review and validation. Do not commit or deploy.
acceptance: Honor the explicitly selected full workflow
Reuse the approved plan and applicable review
Implement and verify acceptance
Do not retest solely for review or shipping
No unauthorized Git delivery or deployment
